(5) Subject to the provisions of this Act and to such directions as may be issued by the Police Service Commission, a person who immediately before the commencement of this Act held office in the Police Force existing before the commencement of this Act is deemed to have been transferred to the Police Force established under this Act on terms and conditions not less favourable than those obtaining immediately before the commencement of this Act and employment in the Police Force existing immediately before the commencement of this Act is deem to be service in the Police Force established under this Act for the purpose of pension.
